# JLPT N5-N2 katakana-only vocabulary, used by zimakuou/audit.py to filter
# common loanwords out of auto-generated glossary draft candidates.
#
# Source: github.com/jamsinclair/open-anki-jlpt-decks (MIT). Filtered to
# entries whose 'expression' field consists ENTIRELY of katakana block
# characters (Unicode ゠-ヿ, range U+30A0-U+30FF).
#
# Rationale: if a word is in JLPT N5-N2, every Japanese-learning audience
# knows it; it's almost certainly not show-specific terminology and
# shouldn't pollute a glossary draft.
#
# Limitations: JLPT vocab is curriculum-scoped, not frequency-ranked.
# Some hugely common loanwords (e.g. スピード, プロジェクト) aren't in
# JLPT at any level — those gap-fill entries live in _KATAKANA_STOPWORDS
# in audit.py rather than here.
#
# Format: one katakana word per line. Lines starting with # are comments.
